blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: In the SnapStats data the row is named simply "Grandview", one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock". Morgan Crossing, the retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street, sits INSIDE Grandview and its homes use this Grandview board row; Morgan Creek is a different sub-area with its own row, never used for Grandview. The street-level board boundary is not verified — no public street-level boundary was opened, and no municipal boundary was substituted.

City planning frame: the City's approved South Surrey land use plans for Grandview Heights include the North Grandview Heights NCP (land uses for the neighbourhoods north of 28 Avenue from King George Boulevard to Highway 15) and the Morgan Heights NCP (the first urban residential neighbourhood in Grandview Heights).

Where the condo stock concentrates: in the Morgan Crossing / Grandview Corners village ground at 24 Avenue / 160 Street — Croydon Drive and 26 Avenue addresses, residences above and beside the shops — inside the wider Grandview attached shelf.

Community context only (whole S Surrey White Rock community, NOT Grandview's prices): Detached median $1,628,000; Condos & Townhomes median $700,000 / $524 per sq ft / 99% sale-to-list / 33 DOM. Per-sub-area medians are not published: Not verified at sub-area level. NOT this area's row, stated to prevent the error: Morgan Creek — Detached 45 / 5 / 11%; Condos & Townhomes 39 / 9 / 23%.
Transit: Not verified — no TransLink timetable for a Grandview route was opened pass.

items.t: Plans and zoning — Surrey: Surrey 2050 OCP Bylaw No. 21900 (adopted Jun 15, 2026) is current — Bylaw 18020 is never cited as current. Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs.

SSMUH — Surrey (adopted Jul 8, 2024): maximum 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop.

ALR block (the plan area is bounded by the ALR on the east per the page's plan frame — parcel status is parcel-specific): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).
